Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. Complete shape_contract, positivity checks and compiler loop reviewed. Shape
CALLS/slot witnesses share example source/context; exemplar HAS_PARSE support is selected
separately. Any same-scope refutation blocks the matching positive cell. Unlike the
explicit prompt compiler comparison, shaped inputs compare ordered slots and per-slot
origin sets. No inference is accepted merely from a parser mood or label.
